messages:
alex: Kicking off NOVA-edge-2 ramp + network failover validation. Posting quick smoke checklist and live notes here. Planning canary at 10% traffic once checks pass.

alex: Checklist I'm running now:
```
1) Control-plane health: k8s API, etcd quorum, controller-manager (ok)
2) GPU attach test: start 3 containers with 1xA100, verify nvidia-smi + driver logs
3) KV cache warm-up: populate prefix cache and validate hit rate > 60% in 5m
4) Network: cross-AZ MTU, BGP sessions, egress NAT, iptables conntrack limits
5) Autoscaling: nodegroup scale-up, pod draining, pre-pull images
6) Cost gate: estimated monthly run-rate with 5% canary vs full ramp
7) Observability: traces, tail-latency dashboards, token-level cost tagging
```

marta: ran control-plane checks, API latency 12ms median, etcd quorum healthy :thumbsup:

raj: ran GPU attach, saw one container fail with driver mismatch. Log: 
```
[2026-03-17T09:12:03Z] container_start error: nvidia-driver: incompat v510 vs expected v525
```
I restarted node and reattached driver module, container started. Flagging driver version pin in bootstrap image.

alex: good catch. please add to infra-image patch: /pkg/drivers/README with pinned versions.

marta: network quickcheck shows asymmetric path for az-b -> az-c, MTU delta 1460 vs 1500 causing fragmentation on jumbo flows. Repro: iperf with 4k payload.

raj: snippet of failing curl to metadata service when path MTU small:
```
curl -v --location http://10.11.0.1:8080/health
* Connection #0 to host 10.11.0.1 left intact
* Reused, but recv timeout
```

samir: MTU mismatch likely from tunnel overlay + host mtu settings. Suggested interim fix: set tun0 mtu=1400 on nodes in az-c and add a netpol to avoid jumbo traffic until we resolve underlying switch config.

alex: agree hold on canary until MTU fix is in place. Can we do quick mitigation script to patch nodes?

marta: pushing small DaemonSet now to set mtu, will run across 100 nodes (rolling). Command: 
```
kubectl apply -f https://internal.tools/net-mtu-patch.yaml --record
```
ETA ~8m for full roll.

infra-cost-bot: Quick cost summary for NOVA-edge-2 (approx):
- baseline reserved schedule (monthly): $28,500
- spot-forward ramp at 30% utilization: $9,200 reduction projected
- 10% canary incremental delta: +$2,300/month
(assumes current GPU mix: 60% A100, 40% T4)

samir: cost numbers look fine. but we should gate full ramp on SLOs, not cost. propose gates: 99th p50/p95 latency, error rate <0.1%, GPU attach success >=99%.

alex: agreed. new decision: hold canary -> run mtu patch -> re-run GPU attach and KV warm-up -> validate traces and cost tagging -> then 10% canary.

marta: mtu patch rolled, verifying. early report: packetloss dropped from 3.4% -> 0.1% on 5m sample.

raj: re-ran GPU attach and KV warm-up. KV hit-rate after priming: 68% at 5m (pass). GPU attach success 100% (3/3).

deployer-bot: Canary deploy (nova-edge-2, canary=10%) started by alex at 2026-03-17T09:21:20Z.

alex: monitoring. please shout if tail-latency or 5xx spikes.

samir: watching dashboards, 5xx stable, p95 latency within expected envelope. holding window 30m before sig ramp.

marta: final note -> added a short preflight to bootstrap docs: 'check-host-mtu.sh' and driver-version check in image build pipeline. Pushing PR: https://gh.internal/redwood/infra/pps/1234

alex: thanks all. will do formal handoff to oncall once 30m observation window passes. :white_check_mark:
